title: A minimal probe of task modeling in language models
abstract: arXiv:2605.02028v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models read long contexts and score well on knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, but neither shows whether a model can do work whose next step depends on everything that came before, as a long-running agent must. We call this ability task modeling and propose counting identical items as its simplest test: every item adds to the total and no item records it. We define counting capacity (CC) as the sequence length up to which a model returns the exact count more often than not, and measure it for 205 models. Every resolved measurement loses count abruptly, at a median of 50 items and at most 627; across release years the median rose 1.6-fold while context windows grew about 80-fold. Changing the counted symbol or the delimiter moves a model's CC severalfold, yet the model accounts for about three quarters of the variance across 16 models and 11 encodings. translated_title: 语言模型中任务建模的最小探针
translated_abstract: 语言模型能够读取长上下文，并在知识和推理基准测试中取得优异成绩，但这两者都无法表明一个模型能否执行下一步依赖于之前所有信息的工作——而这正是长期运行的智能体所必需的能力。我们将这种能力称为“任务建模”，并提出计数相同项目作为其最简单的测试：每个项目都会计入总数，且没有任何项目单独记录它。我们将计数能力定义为模型能以超过一半的概率返回精确计数的序列长度上限，并对205个模型进行了测量。所有已解析的测量都会突然丢失计数，中位数在50个项目处，最多为627个；纵观各发布年份，中位数增长了1.6倍，而上下文窗口却增长了约80倍。改变被计数的符号或分隔符会使模型的CC变化数倍，但在16个模型和11种编码的跨实验中，模型本身约占方差的四分之三。在77个匹配对中，推理模式并未改变中位数CC。
tldr: 该研究提出用“计数相同项目”作为语言模型“任务建模”能力的最小测试，定义了计数能力指标并测量205个模型，发现模型计数会突然失效（中位数仅约50项），其增长远落后于上下文窗口的扩张。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces counting identical items as a minimal probe of "task modeling" in language models, defining counting capacity (CC) and showing that across 205 models, count tracking fails abruptly at a median of 50 items—lagging far behind the growth of context windows.
